full_details: On the post by the Bull, the Rose had a new title, Crack Me This Nut, beside your own house's Two Gentlemen. You read both twice, for the pleasure of the new title. You did not cross the river. The back is not fit for the Bridge again this week, and you had a street to write. At the desk you began the street at the hot end of the day. The talker is still talking. You know he must go, and you have known it since Brooke. You do not know how. You did not write the how. By evening the lane was full of apprentices back from the other bank with the jokes still in them. You shut the casement and went to bed early. On the tables, before the candle: hot day, the street again, the talker.
one_sentence: You read Crack Me This Nut beside Two Gentlemen, and shut the casement on the lane.
title: Read Crack Me This Nut beside Two Gentlemen and shut the casement
